# Hürriyet Daily News

> > Turkey's leading English-language news source covering Turkish politics, Erdoğan diplomacy, Middle East conflicts, and regional security developments.

Hürriyet Daily News provides comprehensive coverage of Turkey's domestic affairs, international relations, and economic developments, with particular focus on President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan's diplomatic initiatives and Turkey's role in Middle East geopolitics. The publication serves as a primary English-language resource for understanding Turkish perspectives on regional conflicts, including Israel-Palestine tensions, Iran crisis developments, and Turkey's strategic position in global affairs.

## Key Topics

- Turkey/Türkiye
- Recep Tayyip Erdoğan
- Erdoğan diplomacy
- Turkey politics
- Middle East conflict
- Israel-Palestine
- Iran crisis
- Regional security
- Istanbul
- Ankara
- Turkish economy

- Turkish news
- Jerusalem
- Lebanon

## Core Pages

- [Turkish News - Latest News from Turkey](https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/): Homepage featuring Turkish news, Erdoğan diplomacy, and regional coverage
- [Türkiye](https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/turkiye/): Main Türkiye news section covering domestic and international affairs
- [About the Newsroom](https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/about-the-newsroom): Newsroom information with editorial staff and contact details

## Turkish Politics & Domestic News

- [CHP candidate İmamoğlu demands mandate](https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/chp-candidate-imamoglu-demands-mandate-142391): Istanbul mayoral election coverage featuring Ekrem İmamoğlu
- [5.3-magnitude shakes southwestern Turkey](https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/53-magnitude-shakes-southwestern-turkey--24012): Earthquake news from Fethiye, Marmaris, and Muğla region

## Economy & Energy

- [Global oil output nearing its peak](https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/global-oil-output-nearing-its-peak-196372): Analysis of global oil production trends and peak oil theory
